states.claim: chunk is a heap-allocated byte buffer of length+MagickPathExtent bytes, or NULL when length is zero; it is released via RelinquishMagickMemory on all chunk-handling paths.
p is set to point into the chunk buffer (p=chunk) when length is nonzero, establishing p's provenance as an interior pointer into chunk storage.
p is advanced within the chunk buffer by MHDR parsing (p+=8, p+=16) and FRAM parsing (p++), preserving its provenance as an interior pointer into chunk.
image is initialized from mng_info->image at function entry.
image is reassigned to the next image in the list after AcquireNextImage/SyncNextImageInList, and mng_info->image is updated to the same object.
image is reassigned to the result of ReadOnePNGImage or ReadOneJNGImage; if NULL, the function returns NULL.
large_image is the newly allocated next image in the list; after magnified processing, the original image is deleted from the list and image is reassigned to large_image.
next and prev are heap-allocated Quantum buffers of length GetPixelChannels(image)*image->columns; both are released via RelinquishMagickMemory after use.
image is reassigned to the first image in the list before coalescing and again after the coalesce block.
image is reassigned to the last image in the list before setting dispose.
mng_info->global_plte is allocated with AcquireQuantumMemory(256, sizeof(*mng_info->global_plte)) when it is NULL and a PLTE chunk is processed.
mng_info->image is updated to point to the current image object at multiple points.
image is closed via CloseBlob before returning or on error paths.

values.claim: In the CLIP handler, p is advanced by 4 after reading first_object and last_object, and object_clip is updated only when (p-chunk) < length-17.
In the MOVE handler, p is advanced by 4 after reading first_object and last_object, and x_off/y_off are updated only when (p-chunk) < length-8.
In the MHDR handler, p is advanced by 8 then by 16, so p[0..7] and p[16..19] are read from the chunk buffer; length must equal 28.
In the DEFI handler, p[0..1] are read for object_id, p[2] for invisible when length>2, p[4..11] for x_off/y_off when length>11, and &p[12] is passed to mng_read_box when length>27.
In the PLTE handler, p[3*i], p[3*i+1], p[3*i+2] are read for i < length/3, so the accessed range is p[0..3*(length/3)-1] within the chunk buffer.
In the tRNS handler, p[i] is read for i < length when 0 < length < 257, so the accessed range is p[0..length-1] within the chunk buffer.
In the MAGN handler, p[0..17] are conditionally read based on length thresholds, so the accessed range is bounded by the chunk buffer only when length is at least the corresponding threshold.
In the bKGD handler, p[0..5] are read when length>5, so the accessed range is p[0..5] within the chunk buffer.
In the BACK handler, p[6] is read when length>6, p[0..5] when mandatory_back and length>5, and p[7..8] when length>8 under MNG_OBJECT_BUFFERS.
In the sBIT handler, p[0..3] are read when length>=4, so the accessed range is p[0..3] within the chunk buffer.
In the pHYs handler, p[0..8] are read when length>8, so the accessed range is p[0..8] within the chunk buffer.
In the gAMA handler, mng_get_long(p) reads p[0..3] when length==4.
values.evidence:

L554: igamma=mng_get_long(p);

For TERM, if length != 0 then p[0] is read as repeat; if repeat == 3 then p[2..9] are read via mng_get_long.

For DEFI, length must be >= 2; object_id is read from p[0..1]; if object_id > MNG_MAX_OBJECTS it is clamped to MNG_MAX_OBJECTS; p[2] is read only if length > 2; p[4..11] only if length > 11; p[12..] only if length > 27.

executions.claim: For CLIP, if length > 3 then first_object=p[0..1], last_object=p[2..3], p+=4; for i in [first_object,last_object], if 0 <= i < MNG_MAX_OBJECTS and exists[i] && !frozen[i] and (p-chunk) < length-17 then mng_read_box reads p[0..] and p is not advanced in the loop.
For DISC/SEEK, if length == 0 or type is SEEK, all objects 1..MNG_MAX_OBJECTS-1 are discarded; else for j=1; j < length; j+=2, i=p[j-1]<<8|p[j] is discarded.

L866: for (j=1; j < (ssize_t) length; j+=2)
L868: i=p[j-1] << 8 | p[j];

executions.claim: For MOVE, if length > 3 then first_object=p[0..1], last_object=p[2..3], p+=4; for i in [first_object,last_object], if 0 <= i < MNG_MAX_OBJECTS and exists[i] && !frozen[i] and (p-chunk) < length-8 then mng_read_pair reads p[0..] and p is not advanced in the loop.
For LOOP, if length > 4 then loop_level=chunk[0] and loop_iters=mng_get_long(&chunk[1]); if loop_iters == 0 then skipping_loop=loop_level.

For ENDL, if length > 0 then loop_level=chunk[0]; if skipping_loop > 0 and skipping_loop == loop_level then skipping_loop=-1 and loop_active[loop_level]=0; else if loop_active[loop_level]==1 then loop_count[loop_level]-- and loop_iteration[loop_level]++.

For MAGN, p[0..1] read if length>1 else magn_first=0; p[2..3] if length>3 else magn_last=magn_first; p[4] if length>4 else magn_methx=0; p[5..6] if length>6 else magn_mx=1; p[7..8] if length>8 else magn_my=magn_mx; p[9..10] if length>10 else magn_ml=magn_mx; p[11..12] if length>12 else magn_mr=magn_mx; p[13..14] if length>14 else magn_mt=magn_my; p[15..16] if length>16 else magn_mb=magn_my; p[17] if length>17 else magn_methy=magn_methx; zero values are replaced by 1 for magn_mx, magn_my, magn_ml, magn_mr, magn_mt, magn_mb.
For sBIT, p[0..3] are read only when length >= 4.
For pHYs, p[0..8] are read only when length > 8.
For IHDR/JHDR processing, if length < 8 then ThrowReaderException; otherwise image_width=mng_get_long(p) and image_height=mng_get_long(&p[4]).
After ReadOnePNGImage/ReadOneJNGImage, if image is NULL return NULL; if image->columns == 0 || image->rows == 0 then CloseBlob and return DestroyImageList(image).

If crop_box differs from image_box+x_off/y_off, then if crop_box.left < crop_box.right && crop_box.top < crop_box.bottom, CropImage is called with crop_info.width=crop_box.right-crop_box.left and crop_info.height=crop_box.bottom-crop_box.top; otherwise image is set to 1x1.
In the backward list traversal, image_count is incremented each iteration and if image_count > 10*mng_info->image_found then ThrowMagickException and return DestroyImageList(image).
If mng_info->image_found == 0 then ThrowMagickException and return DestroyImageList(image).
executions.evidence:

L2275: return(DestroyImageList(image));
